name: Flame Thread
description: Pull a single thin thread of fire out of the palm and flick it across the target's hand.

name: Fire Rope
description: Twist flame into a short rope and loop it round a wrist to hold the arm for a moment.

name: Flame Disc
description: Spin a flat disc of fire in the palm and send it low across the shins.

name: Shape Hold
description: Hold a shaped flame steady between two hands so that later shapes need less qi to form.

name: Ember Veil
description: Fan a thin veil of flame between the user and one incoming strike.

name: Fire Whip
description: Snap a long lash of fire from the wrist that cracks against the target's arm or back.

name: Lash Loop
description: Whip a fire lash round the target's arm and pull so the burn and the tug land together.

name: Woven Curtain
description: Weave many threads of fire into a hanging screen that burns away darts and thrown knives.

name: Scorch Slap
description: Slap a burning open hand across the face or shoulder to scorch and shock.

name: Flame Rake
description: Drag clawed fingers downward in a trail of fire to burn long welts.

name: Brand Fist
description: Hit with a fist that presses a hot mark deep into the target's torso.

name: Heat Sweep
description: Swing a low leg wrapped in flame across both shins of the target.

name: Cinder Counter
description: Beat aside a thrust with a burning hand and slide close to the striker.

name: Searing Press
description: Hold a fiercely hot palm against the target's guard until it chars through and burns the arm beneath.

name: Fire Hammer
description: Bring both fists down in a hammer blow wrapped in dense fire that bursts on contact.

name: Flame Screen
description: Fan a flat sheet of fire up from the ground to cover the front of the body.

name: Glow Veil
description: Hold a thin shimmering veil of heat about the shoulders to curl the flight of light darts.

name: Cinderwheel Guard
description: Whirl a circle of sparks before the body to brush aside thrown darts and pebbles.

name: Half Dome
description: Raise a half circle of fire over the head to catch falling stones and embers.

name: Fume Veil
description: Roll thick smoke from the hands to hide the body from view for a few breaths.

name: Rising Blaze
description: Drive a line of fire up from the ground ahead to stop a rushing opponent.

name: Curtain Fall
description: Drop a sheet of fire from above that guards the user and burns whoever steps into it.

name: Rebound Heat
description: Catch a thrown fire in the curtain and send its heat back as a wave at the caster.

name: Guard Surge
description: Hold a standing curtain and push it forward to drive the opponent back step by step.

name: Smolder Touch
description: Touch a cloth sleeve or a hide to start a slow burn that eats inward.

name: Searing Drag
description: Drag a hot fingertip along the target's arm to leave a thin line of burn.

name: Char Press
description: Press both thumbs into the shoulder muscles so that heat blackens the skin beneath them.

name: Dull Burn
description: Rest a dull flame on a limb and keep it alive so that the pain builds with each breath.

name: Ash Bite
description: Sink a tight spike of hot ash into an unguarded seam of cloth or armor.

name: Coal Press
description: Hold a glowing palm against a limb until the burn forces it to stay still.

name: Long Sear
description: Lock a hand on the target's wrist and pour fire through it until the grip fails.

name: Kindled Wound
description: Light a wound already opened so the flame feeds on it and widens the burn.

name: Quick Spark
description: Throw a bead of fire from the off hand while the main hand is still moving.

name: Flit Flame
description: Skip two steps to the side in a flicker of heat that blurs the outline.

name: Quick Blaze
description: Follow a step with a short flaring palm before the opponent can reset.

name: Heat Rush
description: Charge straight ahead on a blast of heat from the back foot.

name: Burning Wake
description: Run in a curve leaving a line of fire that burns behind the user.

name: Twist Flicker
description: Roll the shoulder with a flare of flame to slip a cut and keep moving.

name: Spark Chain
description: Link three small bolts in one breath so each lands as the guard rises to the last.

name: Flame Skip
description: Skip past an opponent on a gust of heat and burn the near side as the body passes.

name: Rapid Kindle
description: Chain a palm then a bolt then a kick each lit from the last so the burns stack.

name: Leap Flare
description: Jump high in a bright flare that hides the landing spot from the target.

name: Clean Warmth
description: Warm an ally's hands and feet to bring the blood back to them after cold exposure.

name: Fever Pull
description: Draw a mild fever out through the palms of an ally and let the body cool again.

name: Quiet Flame
description: Hold a small flame near a wound and watch how it bends to tell if poison has entered.

name: Kind Ember
description: Set a tiny glowing ember above an ally's bruise to draw out swelling over a slow count.

name: Dry Heat
description: Hold dry heat above an ally's damp chest or wound to ease the ache and keep rot from setting in.

name: Warm Pulse
description: Send warmth through an ally's pulse points to sharpen the senses and firm the grip.

name: Purging Heat
description: Burn a thin poison or taint out of an ally's blood by driving a gentle heat through the veins.

name: Clean Burn
description: Pass a pure flame over an ally's tainted wound to burn out the filth without harming the flesh.

name: Fire Snare
description: Cast a loop of flame at a wrist or ankle so that it snaps tight and holds for a heartbeat.

name: Cinder Cuff
description: Close a ring of glowing cinders on both wrists to bind the hands together briefly.

name: Heat Lock
description: Press a hot palm on the target's qi point to dull the next flow of their qi.

name: Flame Chain
description: Link small flames in a chain between two points to hold a target in place.

name: Burning Tether
description: Tie a long line of fire to an opponent so they cannot move far from the user.

name: Brand Seal
description: Burn a faint mark on the target's chest that blocks one flowing technique for some breaths.

name: Dual Kindle
description: Light a flame in each hand at once to prepare a paired attack.

name: Twin Palm
description: Strike with both burning palms in the same instant on the chest and the shoulder.

name: Ember Pair
description: Throw a spark and an ember on different arcs so that one lands as the other is dodged.

name: Chain Burn
description: Step through three linked small burns in one flowing line of fire.

name: Heat Feint
description: Flare the left hand to draw the eye while the right hand starts the real strike.

name: Rolling Sear
description: Roll one hot strike into the next without a pause so the burns overlap.

name: Rapid Pyre
description: Link five fire strikes from hand and elbow and knee in one unbroken breath.

name: Cross Burn
description: Answer a strike by burning the striking arm and follow at once with a bolt and a palm.
